_comment: FastAPI serving settings. Input bounds for sensor values come from config/validation.json (impossible ranges); thresholds and wording come from config/assessment.json and labels.json.

auth.admin_basis: Firebase custom claim set with the Admin SDK (app/admin_claims.py). The Firestore 'admins' collection holds EVERY app user, so it cannot be used as the admin role.
auth.clock_skew_basis: same allowance as the previous API (prism-ml/prism_api.py verify_id_token(..., clock_skew_seconds=10)); this PC's clock measured 3 s behind Google on 2026-10-19, which makes freshly issued tokens fail as 'used too early' without it. Firebase allows at most 60.

limits.max_weight_basis: same upper bound as the existing PigGrowthIn schema in app/main.py

freshness.max_reading_age_basis: same limit the app uses to trust a one-shot Firestore read (Dashboard_Screen.dart _oneShotGetFreshnessLimitSeconds)

forecast.min_history_coverage_basis: project default, pending review: share of the model's look-back bins that must hold a usable reading before a forecast is returned

registry.lock_stale_basis: project default: a lock older than 6 h is assumed to belong to a crashed job

retrain._comment: POST /admin/retrain reads exports/<dataset_version>/ written by python -m pipeline.export
